document.about: Multi-Plastics 7500 PLA film product information sheet (2 pages, Word 2013). Its properties and applications are Word bulleted lists, whose bullet the PDF maps to U+F0B7, the Symbol font's place for •.

notes: U+F0B7 was not read as a bullet, so it stayed at the head of each item's text and no list was formed. pdftotext gives the same code: the file says it.

checks.issue: #49: the item read  High stiffness, a paragraph.
#49: as above; the bullet is not text.
